items.title: Steve Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 25, 2002
items.q: I had the chance to, actually I shared a floor with Milt Hinton for a few months... I got to see him a couple of times there. And he was just wonderful

ctx.x: And what a great way to be.
Absolutely. You know great music changes the way we can feel about ourselves and about the world. And great musicians can do that. And those are the kind of people — © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-

like being around people like Benny Carter and Joe Wilder, and I had the chance to, actually I shared a floor with Milt Hinton for a few months. We both had our practice studios where the musicians union building is now in New York City. That was where A&R Studios was for many years. And on the fifth floor there was a radio network for the blind. And they had several vacant spaces and I shared a rehearsal room with a guy, and Milt’s room was right next door.
